workloads.name: quickjs-loop
workloads.command: {quickjs} -e 'let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 250000; i++) s = (s + ((i * 17) % 97)) | 0; console.log("quickjs-loop:" + s);'

workloads.name: cpython-json
workloads.description: Parse and serialize JSON repeatedly in CPython.
workloads.command: {python3} -c 'import json; data=[{"i":i,"s":str(i)} for i in range(800)]; total=sum(len(json.loads(json.dumps(data,separators=(",",":")))) for _ in range(40)); print(f"cpython-json:{total}")'

workloads.name: cpython-regex
workloads.description: Regex and text processing loop in CPython.
workloads.command: {python3} -c 'import re; text=("alpha123 beta456 gamma789 delta000\n"*2000); total=sum(len(re.findall(r"[a-z]+\d+", text)) for _ in range(80)); print(f"cpython-regex:{total}")'

workloads.name: aot-curl
workloads.description: Compiler-plugin AOT timing for the curl wasm artifact.

workloads.name: wasm-simd-lanes
workloads.description: Execute a deterministic wasm SIMD lane computation.

workloads.name: process-startup
workloads.command: i=0; while [ $i -lt 20 ]; do {bash} -c true; i=$((i+1)); done; echo process-startup:ok

workloads.name: stdio-pipe
workloads.description: Generate text, pipe through cat, write and read the result.
workloads.command: out=/pipe-$HELIOS_PROCESS_ID.out; copy=/pipe-$HELIOS_PROCESS_ID.copy; i=0; while [ $i -lt 4096 ]; do echo 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef; i=$((i+1)); done | {cat} > $out; {cat} $out > $copy; {cat} $copy >/dev/null; echo stdio-pipe:ok

workloads.name: fs-smallfiles
workloads.description: Create, read, and copy many small files.
workloads.command: dir=/bench-smallfiles-$HELIOS_PROCESS_ID; {mkdir} $dir; i=0; while [ $i -lt 64 ]; do echo data-$i > $dir/f$i; {cat} $dir/f$i > $dir/c$i; i=$((i+1)); done; echo fs-smallfiles:ok

workloads.name: fs-readstream
workloads.description: Sequential read of a larger generated file.
workloads.command: file=/bench-readstream-$HELIOS_PROCESS_ID.in; copy=/bench-readstream-$HELIOS_PROCESS_ID.out; i=0; while [ $i -lt 16384 ]; do echo 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef; i=$((i+1)); done > $file; {cat} $file > $copy; {cat} $copy >/dev/null; echo fs-readstream:ok

workloads.name: curl-local-http
workloads.description: Fetch from a deterministic local HTTP server.
